_doc: The Oathstone Cube (Docs/57_Oathstone_Cube.md; round 43 lane CUBE). Read by Items/BOCube.cpp. Generated by Tools/Design/make_cube.py - edit the generator, never this file.

recipes.Name: Fuse Runes
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier I-II runes
recipes.Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the 3 runes are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new rune comes out

recipes.Name: Kindled Ascent
recipes.Recipe: 2 identical Tier I-II runes + any jewel
recipes.Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the 2 runes and the jewel are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new rune comes out

recipes.Name: Tempered Ascent
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier III runes + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder (the runes and the jewel are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 rune, the next one up the ladder
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new rune comes out

recipes.Name: Dawnbinding
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier IV runes + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder (the runes and the jewel are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new rune comes out

recipes.Name: Oathfire
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical Tier V runes + 2 Radiant jewels
recipes.Result: the next Tier V rune up the ladder (the runes and jewels are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 Tier V rune, the next one up the ladder
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new rune comes out

recipes.Name: Rune Turning
recipes.Recipe: 2 runes of one tier (I-IV)
recipes.Result: 1 random other rune of the same tier, never a higher one (both runes are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random OTHER rune of the same tier
recipes.Keeps: the tier (never higher)

recipes.Name: The Six Kindlings
recipes.Recipe: one of each of the six Tier I runes
recipes.Result: 1 random Tier III rune (the six runes are used up)
recipes.Hint: Six small runes, no two alike, sing one deeper note.
recipes.Makes: 1 random Tier III rune
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new rune comes out

recipes.Name: Rune Breaking
recipes.Recipe: 1 rune of Tier II to V + a Rough jewel
recipes.Result: 2 of the top rune of the tier below it (the rune and the jewel are used up; red runes do not break)
recipes.Hint: The roughest stone can split a rune back into its makers.
recipes.Makes: 2 runes of the top kind of the tier below it
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the 2 runes come out

recipes.Name: Red Rune Turning
recipes.Recipe: 3 red runes of any kind + a Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: 1 red rune of your choice
recipes.Makes: 1 red rune, the one you chose
recipes.UsesUp: the 3 red runes and the jewel
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the chosen red comes out

recipes.Name: Jewel Polishing
recipes.Recipe: 3 identical jewels (Rough to Faceted)
recipes.Result: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer (the 3 jewels are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer
recipes.Keeps: the family

recipes.Name: The Prism
recipes.Recipe: an Ember, a Frost and a Storm jewel of one cut
recipes.Result: 1 Prism jewel of that cut (the 3 jewels are used up)
recipes.Hint: Fire, frost and storm, cut alike, fold into one light.
recipes.Makes: 1 Prism jewel of that cut
recipes.Keeps: the cut

recipes.Name: Jewel Kindling
recipes.Recipe: 2 identical jewels (Rough to Faceted) + a Tier III+ rune
recipes.Result: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer (the jewels and the rune are used up)
recipes.Hint: Two twin jewels are one short. A strong rune pays for the third.
recipes.Makes: 1 jewel of the same family, one cut finer
recipes.Keeps: the family

recipes.Name: Jewel Cleaving
recipes.Recipe: one jewel alone (Cut or finer)
recipes.Result: 2 jewels of the same family, one cut rougher
recipes.Makes: 2 jewels of the same family, one cut rougher
recipes.Keeps: the family

recipes.Name: Jewel Turning
recipes.Recipe: 3 jewels of one cut
recipes.Result: 1 random jewel of the same cut, any family, never finer (the 3 jewels are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random jewel of the same cut, any family
recipes.Keeps: the cut (never finer)

recipes.Name: Rune Pressing
recipes.Recipe: 3 runes of one tier (I-III)
recipes.Result: 1 random jewel, one cut finer than the runes' tier (the 3 runes are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random jewel, one cut finer than the runes
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the jewel comes out

recipes.Name: Jewel Binding
recipes.Recipe: 4 jewels of one cut (Cut or finer)
recipes.Result: 1 random rune of the jewels' tier (the 4 jewels are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random rune of the jewels' tier
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the rune comes out

recipes.Name: Oathmark
recipes.Recipe: a rare + a Tier V+ rune + a Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: the same rare with one more socket past its limit (up to 2); its mods stay
recipes.Hint: The highest rune and the finest stone can break a rare's oath.
recipes.Makes: the same rare, 1 socket past its limit (up to 2)
recipes.Keeps: every mod, base, level, socketed rune

recipes.Name: Socket Boring
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield + any rune + any jewel
recipes.Result: the same item with one more socket (magic up to 2, rare up to 1); its mods stay
recipes.Makes: the same item, 1 more socket (magic up to 2, rare 1)
recipes.Keeps: every mod, base, level, socketed rune

recipes.Name: Family Reforge
recipes.Recipe: a rare item or rare idol + 3 jewels of one family
recipes.Result: the rare with ALL its mods rerolled, one sure to be of the jewels' family; base, sockets and level stay
recipes.Makes: the rare, ALL mods rolled new, 1 of the jewels' family
recipes.Keeps: base, item level, sockets, runes

recipes.Name: Family Imbuing
recipes.Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour + 1 jewel
recipes.Result: a magic item of the same base, one mod sure to be of the jewel's family
recipes.Makes: a magic item, 1 mod of the jewel's family
recipes.Keeps: base and item level

recipes.Name: Family Infusing
recipes.Recipe: a magic item with one line + 2 Rough jewels of one family
recipes.Result: the same magic item; its line stays and it gains one line of the jewels' family (Ember = fire, Frost = cold, Storm = lightning)
recipes.Makes: the magic item + 1 line of the jewels' family
recipes.Keeps: its line, base, item level, sockets, runes

recipes.Name: Gear Fusing
recipes.Recipe: 3 magic items of one slot, nothing socketed
recipes.Result: a rare on the base of the lowest item level of the three, rolled at that item level; all its mods are new
recipes.Makes: a rare of that slot, all mods new
recipes.Keeps: the base and item level of the lowest of the three

recipes.Name: Awakening
recipes.Recipe: a magic item + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: a rare of the same base and item level; all its mods are new (a magic idol keeps its lines and gains new ones)
recipes.Makes: a rare of the same base, all mods new
recipes.Keeps: base, item level, sockets, runes

R85.Recipe: a magic item or a magic idol + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
R85.Result: a rare of the same base and item level; a magic item gets all new mods, a magic idol keeps its lines and gains new ones (this is how a magic idol becomes a rare idol)
R85.Makes: a rare, same base; all mods new (an idol keeps its lines and gains new ones)

recipes.Name: Restring
recipes.Recipe: a magic item + any jewel
recipes.Result: the magic item with ALL its mods rerolled; base and level stay
recipes.Makes: the magic item, ALL mods rolled new (can be worse)
recipes.Keeps: base, item level, sockets, runes

recipes.Name: Base Ascension
recipes.Recipe: any gear + 1 rune of Tier III or higher + 2 jewels of any colour, each Cut, Faceted or Radiant
recipes.Result: the same item on the next base of its kind (same defence type, never lower); mods and sockets stay
recipes.Makes: the same item on the next base of its kind (same defence type, never lower)
recipes.Keeps: every mod, item level, sockets, runes, the defence type

recipes.Name: Retempering
recipes.Recipe: a rare + 2 Tier II+ runes + a jewel of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: the rare with ALL its mods rerolled at this rupture's level (only above the item's level)
recipes.Makes: the rare, ALL mods rolled new at this rupture's level
recipes.UsesUp: 2 runes, the jewel + every old mod
recipes.Keeps: base, sockets, runes

R85.Result: the rare with ALL its mods rolled again; its item level rises to this Rupture's monster level (84 at most). Works only when that monster level is above the item's level
R85.Makes: item level = monster level (max 84), mods new

recipes.Name: Runesmith's Base
recipes.Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour (ML 30+) + 2 identical Tier I runes
recipes.Result: the same white base with its most sockets
recipes.Makes: the same white base with its most sockets
recipes.Keeps: the base and its item level

recipes.Name: Runesmith's Count
recipes.Recipe: a plain white weapon or armour (ML 30+) + 3 identical Tier I runes
recipes.Result: the same white base with exactly 3 sockets
recipes.Makes: the same white base with exactly 3 sockets (a base whose most is 2 cannot take it)
recipes.Keeps: the base and its item level

recipes.Name: Red Ascent
recipes.Recipe: 3 reds of one tier (I-III)
recipes.Result: 1 random red of the next tier (the 3 reds are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random red of the next tier
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new red comes out

recipes.Name: Red Turning
recipes.Recipe: 2 reds of one tier + any rune
recipes.Result: 1 random other red of the same tier; red Dwarven Runes and red idols stay in their kind (the reds and the rune are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random OTHER red of the same tier (Dwarven Runes and idols stay in their kind)
recipes.Keeps: the tier

recipes.Name: Red Descent
recipes.Recipe: a red of Tier II to IV + any rune
recipes.Result: 1 random red of the tier below it (the red and the rune are used up)
recipes.Makes: 1 random red of the tier below
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the new red comes out

recipes.Name: Red Reawakening
recipes.Recipe: a red + 2 jewels of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: the same red, its values rerolled inside their ranges (can roll lower); tier stays. Reds with fixed values are refused
recipes.Makes: the same red, its values rolled again (can roll lower)
recipes.Keeps: the red, its tier, item level, fixed lines (values that never reroll)

recipes.Name: Red Retempering
recipes.Recipe: a red + a Tier IV+ rune + a Faceted or Radiant jewel
recipes.Result: the same red, its values rerolled in their ranges and its item level raised (values never grow with level). Reds with fixed values are refused
recipes.Makes: the same red at this rupture's level, values rolled again
recipes.Keeps: the red, its tier, fixed lines (values that never reroll)

R85.Result: the same red, its values rolled again in their ranges; its item level rises to this Rupture's monster level (84 at most). Reds with fixed values are refused
R85.Makes: item level = monster level (max 84), values new

recipes.Name: Red Unmaking
recipes.Recipe: a red alone
recipes.Result: 2 random jewels, finer for a higher tier (the red is destroyed)
recipes.Makes: 2 random jewels, finer for a higher red tier
recipes.Keeps: nothing, the red is destroyed

recipes.Name: The Perfect Echo
recipes.Recipe: two copies of the same red
recipes.Result: one red with every value at its best (the other copy is used up)
recipes.Hint: Two reds, the same in all but luck, keep only their best.
recipes.Makes: 1 copy of the red with every value at its best
recipes.Keeps: the red itself

recipes.Name: Vowbinding: the Mark
recipes.Recipe: a red + a Marked base of the same kind + a Tier V+ rune
recipes.Result: the same red on the Marked base: every red value kept, the Mark becomes its implicit, the higher item level
recipes.Hint: A red may leave its body for one the Core has touched, if a high rune pays the toll.
recipes.Makes: the red on the Marked base, the Mark its implicit
recipes.UsesUp: the red's old base, the Marked item's own mods, the rune
recipes.Keeps: every red value, sockets, runes, the higher item level

recipes.Name: Vowbinding: a Vow
recipes.Recipe: a red + a rare of the same slot + a Tier V+ rune (the first Vow; then 1, 2, 3... red runes)
recipes.Result: the same red with the rare's finest mod (best tier first, never an idol's +1 count line) as a Vow; a Vow of the same kind is replaced
recipes.Hint: Feed a red the finest line of a rare that shares its place: a high stone for the first vow, red stones for every vow after.
recipes.Makes: the red + 1 Vow: the rare's finest mod
recipes.UsesUp: the rare and the runes (Tier V+ for the first Vow, then 1, 2, 3... red runes)
recipes.Keeps: every red value, base, Mark, the other Vows
recipes.Recipe83: a red + a rare of the same slot + a Tier V+ rune (the first Vow; then 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 red runes)
recipes.UsesUp83: the rare and the runes (Tier V+ for the first Vow, then 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 red runes)
recipes.Result83: the same red with the rare's finest mod (best tier first, never its Oathsworn line or an idol's +1 count line) as a Vow; each Vow counts for less than the one before (100, 85, 70, 60, 50, 40%); a Vow of the same kind is replaced
recipes.Makes83: the red + 1 Vow: the rare's finest mod, at its Vow's share

recipes.Name: Sigil Binding
recipes.Recipe: 3 Tier III or IV sigils + 1 red rune
recipes.Result: 1 Unique Sigil in your pouch: a reward past the cap and a crimson penalty (the sigils are used up)
recipes.Hint: Three strong sigils and one red stone bind into a map key no Gemwright sells.
recipes.Makes: 1 Unique Sigil: wealth sigils make the Hoardking, horde and champions the Endless Muster, augury and omens the Broken Seer
recipes.UsesUp: the 3 sigils and the red rune
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the Unique Sigil comes out (into your pouch)

recipes.Name: Oath Binding
recipes.Recipe: 1 Unique Sigil + 2 red runes (or 1 red Oath Sigil + 2 red runes)
recipes.Result: 1 red Oath Sigil in your pouch, at the tier your best Rupture Level reaches (a red Oath Sigil goes one tier up). The Unique Sigil is used up
recipes.Hint: A Unique Sigil and two red stones swear a map key with an Oath on it.
recipes.Makes: 1 red Oath Sigil: a rule, a burden and a sure Promise. It counts as 2 Sigils and breaks if you die. A red Oath Sigil in goes up one tier
recipes.UsesUp: the Unique or red Oath Sigil and the 2 red runes
recipes.Keeps: nothing, only the red Oath Sigil comes out (into your pouch)

recipes.Name: Idol Merging
recipes.Recipe: 3 magic 1-cell idols + any jewel
recipes.Result: 1 idol of 3 cells (1x3 or 3x1). It keeps the first idol's first line, rerolled in its tier; its other line is new. The 3 idols and the jewel are used up
recipes.Makes: 1 idol of 3 cells, its 2nd line new
recipes.Keeps: the FIRST idol's first line (value rerolled in its tier)

R85.Makes: 3 cells: line 1 from your FIRST idol, line 2 new
R85.Keeps: the line of the idol in the first cube slot, bigger (put your best idol there)

recipes.Name: Idol Fusing
recipes.Recipe: 3 magic 2-cell idols + a jewel of Cut or finer
recipes.Result: 1 idol of 4 cells (1x4 or 4x1). It keeps the first idol's first line, rerolled in its tier; its other line is new. The 3 idols and the jewel are used up
recipes.Makes: 1 idol of 4 cells, its 2nd line new
recipes.Keeps: the FIRST idol's first line (value rerolled in its tier)

R85.Makes: 4 cells: line 1 from your FIRST idol, line 2 new
R85.Keeps: the line of the idol in the first cube slot, bigger (put your best idol there)

recipes.Name: Blank Slate
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield + 2 Tier II+ runes
recipes.Result: the same base as a plain white, its item level, Mark, Quality and sockets kept (every mod is used up)
recipes.Makes: the same base, white: an Oathword base
recipes.Keeps: base and Mark, item level, Quality, sockets

recipes.Name: Oathsworn
recipes.Recipe: a rare + a Tier V+ rune + 3 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: the same rare with one more line, its Oathsworn line: rolled from its own pool at the best tier its item level allows (a full rare holds 7 lines); a Vow can never take it
recipes.Makes: the rare + its Oathsworn line (one more line, at its best tier)
recipes.UsesUp: the rune and 3 Core Embers (a held Oathsworn line rolls again)
recipes.Keeps: every line, its base, its sockets

R85.Result: the same rare + a 7th line, its Oathsworn line: a new mod at the top tier its item level allows (again: that line rolls again; a Vow never copies it)
R85.Makes: the rare + a 7th line: a new mod at its top tier
R85.Keeps: every other line, its base, its sockets

recipes.Name: Idol Tempering
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol + 1 Tier III or IV rune
recipes.Result: the same idol: every line keeps its kind, its tier and value are rolled again within the idol's item level (it can be worse)
recipes.Makes: the idol, every line's tier rolled again
recipes.Keeps: every line's kind, its size, its item level

recipes.Name: Resist Turning
recipes.Recipe: an item with a resistance line + 1 Tier I to IV rune + 1 Core Ember (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: your spare resistance line turns into the one you lack most (Fire, Cold, Lightning; Poison from Rupture Level 100), same tier, same roll
recipes.Makes: your spare resistance becomes the one you lack most
recipes.Keeps: that line's tier and roll, every other line

recipes.Name: Idol Mending
recipes.Recipe: a rare idol + 1 Tier III or IV rune + 1 jewel of Cut or finer + 2 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: the same idol: its weakest line melts and a new line of the same kind pours in; every other line stays
recipes.Makes: the idol with its weakest line (lowest tier, then lowest roll) rolled anew
recipes.UsesUp: the rune, the jewel and 2 Core Embers
recipes.Keeps: every other line, its size, its item level

recipes.Name: Idol Filling
recipes.Recipe: a rare idol with a free line + 1 Tier III or IV rune + 2 jewels of Cut or finer + 4 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: the same idol gains 1 new random line of a kind it has room for (3 prefixes and 3 suffixes at most); every other line stays
recipes.Makes: the idol with 1 new line (never a +1 line)
recipes.UsesUp: the rune, 2 jewels and 4 Core Embers
recipes.Keeps: every line, its size, its item level

recipes.Name: Dwarven Carving
recipes.Recipe: a Normal or Magic Dwarven Rune + 1 Tier III or IV rune + 2 jewels of Cut or finer + Core Embers from your Forge store (4 for Magic, 10 for Rare)
recipes.Result: the Dwarven Rune comes out one rarity up (Normal to Magic, Magic to Rare) with its lines rolled new; the rune, 2 jewels and the Embers are used up
recipes.Makes: the same Dwarven Rune one rarity up, new lines
recipes.UsesUp: the rune, 2 jewels and the Core Embers
recipes.Keeps: nothing but its place in your bag

recipes.Name: Dwarven Mending
recipes.Recipe: a Rare Dwarven Rune + 1 Tier III or IV rune + 1 jewel of Cut or finer + 3 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: its weakest line melts and a new line of the same kind pours in; every other line stays
recipes.Makes: the Dwarven Rune with 1 new line
recipes.UsesUp: the rune, the jewel and 3 Core Embers
recipes.Keeps: its other lines and its place in your bag

recipes.Name: Idol Turning
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol of 2 to 4 cells + 1 Tier I or II rune
recipes.Result: the same idol turned on its side (1x3 becomes 3x1, and back): every line, its tier and its roll kept
recipes.Makes: the idol turned on its side, every line kept
recipes.Keeps: every line, its tier and roll, item level

recipes.Name: Idol Resist Turning
recipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol with a resistance line + 2 runes of Tier I to IV + 1 Core Ember (from your Forge store)
recipes.Result: Its resistance line turns to the next element the idol lacks (Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Fire). Same tier, same roll. Turn again for the one you want
recipes.Makes: its resistance turns to the next element
recipes.Keeps: that line's tier and roll, every other line

recipes.Name: Idol Binding
recipes.Recipe: 2 magic or rare idols of the same size, put in the one you keep FIRST (Gloomsilver from your Forge store and gold are taken)
recipes.Result: The first idol takes the finest line of the second that fits, tier and roll kept. The second idol is used up. Costs 1 Gloomsilver and 5,000 gold per item level per line
recipes.Makes: the first idol with one more line
recipes.UsesUp: the second idol, Gloomsilver and gold
recipes.Keeps: every line of the first idol; a +1 line never moves

recipes.Name: Regrading
recipes.Recipe: any gear with a Base Grade under 90 + 1 rune of Tier II or higher + 1 jewel, Cut, Faceted or Radiant
recipes.Result: the same item with its Base Grade rolled again on the drop odds (it can be lower)
recipes.Makes: the same item with a new Base Grade, 1 to 100 (it can be lower)
recipes.Keeps: every mod, item level, base, sockets, runes, quality

recipes.Name: Regrading, Grade 90+
recipes.Recipe: any gear with Base Grade 90 or more + 1 rune of Tier III or higher + 2 jewels, Cut, Faceted or Radiant
recipes.Result: the same item with its Base Grade rolled again on the drop odds (it can be lower)
recipes.Makes: the same item with a new Base Grade, 1 to 100 (it can be lower)
recipes.Keeps: every mod, item level, base, sockets, runes, quality
